title: Headless mesh render CLI (PNG export)
description: Add a small Java CLI (or reuse existing entry pattern) that: initializes HeadlessGL/offscreen context, loads a .dsl file, executes NodeGraphRuntime to mesh, renders with existing mesh shading path to an offscreen framebuffer, reads pixels, writes PNG. Goal: deterministic screenshots and Daud/ticket-worker coverage without requiring a live desktop automation server. Related: MESH-31 Docker headless exploration; automation /ui/screenshot today requires running app.
definition-of-done: 1. Documented CLI main class or exec profile in ixdar-app pom.xml. 2. Produces a PNG for at least one bundled sample DSL (e.g. cube or curve_sweep_tube). 3. Uses existing GL abstraction (HeadlessGL) without per-frame direct buffer leaks. 4. Non-zero exit and stderr on DSL/render failures. 5. README or ticket testing-plan documents JVM flags / Mesa if needed for CI.
testing-plan: 1. mvn -P <profile> run against sample DSL writes PNG. 2. File exists and non-empty; spot-check dimensions. 3. Optional: wire into Daud or ixdar-cli as follow-up ticket.
todos: DONE : Spike HeadlessGL init + simple clear color PNG
DONE : Load DSL + execute to HalfEdgeMesh/ArrayMesh
DONE : Reuse minimal mesh draw path to FBO
DONE : PNG write and CLI flags (-Ddsl.file, -Dout.png)
DONE : Document headless/Mesa constraints for Linux CI
